protocol.reason: Production behavior can be tested with independent fixtures.
protocol.title: Controlled comparison of production transformation contracts
protocol.question: How does production transformation preserve protected input values?
protocol.research_gap: Existing methods do not characterize protected-value violations under the proposed workload families.
protocol.expected_contribution: Identify the conditions that cause protection failures and their relationship to the studied mechanism.
protocol.comparison_rationale: A targeted ablation isolates the protection mechanism without asserting competitive performance.
protocol.sampling_rationale: Seeded workload families cover the specified structural variations; conclusions remain within this generated domain.

metrics.name: error
metrics.description: Number of independently detected contract violations.

protocol.comparator: The ablation removes the guard while preserving remaining behavior.
protocol.independent_oracle: An independent fixture generator computes exact preserved values.
protocol.sampling_unit: A generated input with protected values and independently known output.
procedure: Compare both against independent expected outputs.
protocol.analysis_method: Descriptive summaries and differences paired by seed and fixture.
limitations: Synthetic cases cannot establish behavior in natural input populations.
One source snapshot does not establish universal software correctness.
literature_queries: software testing independent oracle controlled study

validation_contract.sampling_basis: Synthetic independent seed-cluster assumption, not a scientific population claim.
